comments: The free scan needs neither an account nor an email address. Automated findings are deliberately separated from human-review items; the tool does not issue a conformance certificate or legal verdict.
features: Free, no-account browser-based accessibility scan for EU-facing online shops. It checks up to four public buying-path pages with automated WCAG rules, separates confirmed findings from items needing human review, and maps results to relevant EAA and EN 301 549 references. It does not certify compliance.
title: Includora
